tagline: The Andaman hub — islands close in, a cross-border corridor reaching out.
summary: Phuket anchors the Andaman: Phi Phi, Phang Nga Bay, Krabi and the Similan group are all high-demand hops handled by Pioneer II, while Quanta-LR's hybrid range opens the cross-border Andaman corridor to Langkawi. It is the natural SEA west-coast counterpart to the Bali cluster.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: All-electric day-trip hops to Phi Phi, Phang Nga and Krabi from the established marina base, with berth-pedestal charging.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Opens the cross-border Andaman corridor Phuket ↔ Langkawi (~107 nm) as a smooth single hybrid leg with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

transit_planning: For an authority or operator: a premium, low-emission water tier relieving the crowded Andaman speedboat corridors, plus a cross-border luxury line to Langkawi.

grab.note: Phuket is Grab Phase 3 — the Andaman hub and the Langkawi cross-border corridor.
